# Outrush.si

> Outrush.si is a domain name offered for acquisition by Sohadot. It is not an operating company, product or service.

- Positioning: Intelligence in Motion. A commercial thesis about intelligence moving from concentrated capability into deployment and impact, not a technical claim.
- outrush (noun): an act of rushing out; a rapid outflow. Source: https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/outrush
- outrush (verb, American football): to rush for more yards than an opponent. Source: https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/outrush
- Additional dictionary references: https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/outrush and https://www.dictionary.com/browse/outrush
- .si is Slovenia's country-code top-level domain. Super Intelligence is a possible branding reading, not the domain's official meaning.
- Domain inquiries: https://outrush.si/acquire/
- Marketplace listing: https://www.dynadot.com/fr/market/user-listings/outrush.si
- Direct inquiries: agent@sohadot.com
- The seller may arrange completion through Dynadot or Escrow.com after agreement.
